notes.title: Update 1.01: Tooltips
notes.content:
In response to player feedback regarding the lack of transparency in turret stats and turret use cases, I've made a small but good quality-of-life improvement. You can now simply hover over any purchased turret to view all relevant information instantly. This includes summarized stats as well as stage-specific status effects and duration where applicable.

This update aims to make accessing important information more intuitive and efficient, contributing to a smoother and more informed gameplay experience.

Thanks for playing so far!
